guidance.text: The Company expects continued strong momentum in 2026 and is raising its revenue target for the full year to $525 – $550 million, which represents a greater than 10-fold increase from 2025 results. This updated target includes revenue expected from Cyberhawk during the second half of 2026.

management.text: “Our team at Ondas is performing at a high level, as evidenced by our record second-quarter results, headlined by strong revenue growth and continued bookings momentum across our business,” said Eric Brock, Chairman and CEO of Ondas. “We expect to sustain this momentum and deliver another significant revenue ramp during the second half of 2026, increasing our full-year 2026 revenue target to a range of $525 million to $550 million.”

management.text: “Joining Marvell creates a company uniquely positioned to capitalize on a market opportunity of $550 billion and generate significant, sustainable stockholder value,” said Michael Hurlston, President and CEO of Lumentum. “Surging AI data traffic requires rapid hardware innovation, and this combination enhances our ability to deliver next-generation solutions at scale. Together with Marvell, we will meet our customers’ complete interconnect needs, spanning scale-across and scale-out today to scale-up and scale-in domains tomorrow. By offering extreme co-design around our customers’ demanding requirements, we will help them achieve faster time to market, accelerated innovation cycles, and category-defining performance.”

Together with Marvell, we will meet our customers’ complete interconnect needs, spanning scale-across and scale-out today to scale-up and scale-in domains tomorrow. By offering extreme co-design around our customers’ demanding requirements, we will help them achieve faster time to market, accelerated innovation cycles, and category-defining performance.”

management.text: Following closing, Matt Murphy will continue as Chairman and CEO of the combined company. As part of the transaction, three members of Lumentum’s Board of Directors, including Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston, will join Marvell’s Board, which currently consists of seven directors.
